env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^2 3 5$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -o $WORK/upstream$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/upstream$GOEXE
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/comptimehead

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"comptime"
	"fmt"
)

type Pt struct {
	X int
	Y int
}

func /* a */ Count /* b */ [ /* c */ T any /* d */ ] /* e */ () int {
	n := 0
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		_ = f
		n++
	}
	return n
}

func
// line comment between the keyword and the name
Wide[T any, U any]() int {
	n := 0
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		_ = f
		n++
	}
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[U]() {
		_ = f
		n++
	}
	return n
}

func Tight[T any]() int {
	n := 0
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		_ = f
		n++
	}
	return n
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(Count[Pt](), Count[struct{ A, B, C int }](), Wide[Pt, struct{ A, B, C int }]())
	_ = Tight[Pt]()
}
